candidates.snippet: @SternDrewCrypto This is a poor rip of @flightradar24 data from *three months ago* https://t.co/MvPOiFEwdl

Houthi forces managed to hit a Saudi Air Force Eurofighter Typhoon operating over northern Yemen overnight. 

The missile detonated above and ahead of the Saudi Typhoon, damaging its starboard wing, with the pilot managing to nurse his wounded aircraft back to friendly territory.
